intro: The handshake emoji 🤝 is the internet's shorthand for a done deal, a warm hello, and 'nice to meet you' all at once — the two hands that seal an agreement or open a conversation. This page gathers the whole greeting-and-agreement range: the clasped 🤝 handshake and its directional 🫱 🫲 hands, waving 👋 and open-palm hellos, the 💼 briefcase and 🙌 celebration hands of a closed deal, and friendly greeting kaomoji like ( ・∇・)ノ for when plain text needs a wave. Grab a single symbol, or copy a ready-made combo set for intros, agreements, and business chats.
